description: Step 2 of 2 (needs a network:publish key): publish exactly what create_public_tracker or preview_network_watch showed (its revisionId) as a public tracker people can follow. On its own it is a tracker with one source, its own page; with trackerRef or trackerTitle it also joins one of the person's trackers with several sources, or starts one. Returns the address to share. Publishing cannot be undone for anyone who saw it; the person can withdraw it later.

trackerDescription.description: What the new tracker is for, for people deciding to follow it

trackerRef.description: One of your trackers with several sources to add it to; leave out, with trackerTitle, for a tracker of its own

trackerTitle.description: Start a new tracker with several sources, with this one first; leave out for a tracker of its own

name: publish_tracker
title: Publish a monitor as a public tracker
